signal.note: num_turns=2; persist_samples=2 recalled=False. user_saw was previously recorded False but that was an ARTIFACT: the headless probe measures `sentinel in rt3` where rt3 is the `claude -p` JSON result envelope (the model's reply text), which structurally cannot contain a hook's additionalContext regardless of TTY rendering. So False was guaranteed by construction, not observed. Per the harness convention (Signal.user_saw docstring), a channel the headless probe cannot observe must be null, not False. DOCUMENTED + HUMAN-VERIFIED 2026-06-26: the official Claude Code hooks docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks.md, Stop section) state Stop additionalContext is `shown as 'Stop hook feedback' in transcript` — user-visible BY DESIGN. Confirmed live (interactive `claude` TTY, IDA_GATE_MODE=warn): the TUI renders it as a `Stop hook feedback:` notice ALONGSIDE the short systemMessage, so the real interactive value is user_saw=TRUE. The U? in table_cell is the HEADLESS harness's blindness, not genuine ambiguity. Needs a PTY/tmux oracle to measure in-harness.
